name: HandsetUpgradeEligibilityDesk
tagline: Who can upgrade, what it costs and what their old phone is worth – in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete device-upgrade desk for mobile operators, MVNOs and dealers: eligibility from contract end and device-plan paid %, buy-out for early upgrades, payment and credit rules, trade-in grading, offer builder with guardrails and approval, and a case pipeline from New to Fulfilled. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Eligibility engine: upgrade window, paid % threshold, buy-out amount and date
Refer / blocked rules for missed payments, arrears and credit
Trade-in grading checklist with grade values and activation-lock check
Offer builder: catalogue, offers, trade-in, upfront, 24/36-month terms, current vs new monthly
Status workflow with enforced rules, drag-and-drop pipeline and keyboard moves
Bulk assign, follow-ups, CSV export and undo
Power Fx outputs and events incl. QuoteJson
controlType: standard (2 controls: HandsetUpgradeEligibilityDesk data-set + HandsetUpgradeEligibilityDeskPortal field)
